'''Obi-Wan Kenobi's second lightsaber''' was the weapon constructed and wielded by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from around [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]<ref name="Jedi Quest 2" /> to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] identical to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|his original weapon]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Specifications==
[[File:Obi-Wan_The_Changing_of_the_Guard.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Obi-Wan Kenobi using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while teaching his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].]]
Obi-Wan Kenobi crafted this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] almost exactly the same as his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's first lightsaber/Legends|original one]]: A design based upon his [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|former master's]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that featured a solid hilt with the exception of the handgrip surrounding the main [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]].<ref name="CVD" /> Presented with an opportunity to modify the design, Obi-Wan made the new lightsaber moisture-resistant, after recalling a mishap during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], when his original saber shorted out when immersed in water.<ref name="FactFile33">{{FactFile|33|LIG 5-6|Obi-Wan Kenobi's Lightsaber}}</ref>

The emitter barrel had all of the controls mounted onto it, which included a red activator, a bezeled blade length and intensity control directly above it, a gold blade power adjust knob adjacent to it, all surrounding the ridged housing for the blade modulation circuitry. This was separated from the body of the weapon by a cut-back portion, which also held the internal [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|blade crystals]].<ref name="CVD" />

Immediately below was the main body with a scalloped handgrip, which thickened near the bottom of the section where the [[charging port]] was, concealed by the belt clip. The pommel was a black sphere and housed the power cell reserve cap which had six evenly spaced protrusions around the pommel.<ref name="CVD" />

==History==
[[File:Fight_on_Kamino.png|thumb|left|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi using his lightsaber against [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].]]
After being promoted to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Obi-Wan Kenobi rebuilt his lightsaber in the style of his first lightsaber, which was lost during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Second Battle of Theed]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in his duel with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref>{{Film|I}}</ref><ref name="Guide" />

This model was created by [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="Jedi Quest 2" /> succeeding Kenobi's use of his [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|former master's]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref>''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref> and saw action during many missions.<ref>''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' </ref> Some of those missions took Kenobi to [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]],<ref>''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]''</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="Showdown">''[[Jedi Quest: The Final Showdown]]''</ref> and the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref>''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> Obi-Wan used this weapon to kill [[Granta Omega]] in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Showdown" />

Kenobi also used this lightsaber at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant Underlevels]] to slice off [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell's]] arm.<ref name="AOTC" /> He also used this lightsaber against bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], his upgrades to the saber proving invaluable in the planet's watery climate.<ref name="FactFile33" /> It was lost on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] took Kenobi captive, and disarmed him.<ref name="AOTC" />

He would later build a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|third lightsaber]] after his promotion to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==

The exact creation date of Kenobi's second lightsaber is unclear, with him continuing to use Qui-Gon's as late as 29 BBY in ''[[Rogue Planet]]''. The future sections of ''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: The Followers]]'', set later in 29 BBY, do not specify the appearance of Kenobi's lightsaber during that time, while the cover illustration's depiction of both past and future elements also makes identification difficult. The [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest (comic series)|comicbook adaptation]] of ''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]'', set in 28 ABY, is the earliest in-universe source to explicitly portray Kenobi's second blue saber, with the distinctive hilt that mimics its predecessor.

Kenobi's lightsaber in ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' resembles the one he wielded during [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] although he possessed a new one shortly after Geonosis.
